name: 15146 · Monroeville, PA
findings: ZIP 15146 (Monroeville) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15146 (Monroeville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
